name: status
title: Status and badge
description: Status glyph + text (shape survives forced colours); square code badge.
whenToUse: Use Status for a state in words with a glyph, and Badge for a short code label. For a message that needs explanation use Notice.

parts.name: Badge
parts.description: A square code badge: mono text in a 1px frame. Never cut, never a pill. `tone="signal"` is the only filled form.

parts.name: Status
parts.description: Status = glyph shape + text. The shape carries meaning in grayscale and forced colours; only attention is red.
